blocks.text: *Ar-Rashīd* is the One whose dispositions lead on to their ultimate aims as a result of right ways-of-behaving without the advice of a counsellor, the directions of a director, or the guidance of a guider; and (this one) is God Most High. A man may be (said to be) a guider to the extent that he is guided in his dispositions to the attainment of right conduct in respect of his religious and secular ends.
